I replied to Kwame in #coastal-team: the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics was 03.11.2025.

That date comes from Moss's digest dated 02.11.2025, which says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's recap note from 08.12.2025 also gives 03.11.2025 as the official handoff. The same note says he took over day to day on 22.11.2025, so I included that date too in case the CRM needs it.

I wrote the dates as day.month.year, the format Kwame asked for in his DM.
